title: Expanded AI courses to meet demand
summary: Three of my AI courses were oversubscribed, so I got each expanded to 30 seats; all three filled again.
what_would_have_happened: Engineers who wanted the training would have waited for a later run.
the_call: Meet demand now by raising the seat limits on the scheduled sessions.
what_i_did: Asked the learning team to raise enrollment limits for all three sessions.
what_changed: Each session grew to 30 seats and filled again, confirming continued demand.
